newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Toolex Alpha to buy ODME International.
newsitem.headline: Toolex Alpha to buy ODME International.

text.p: Optical discs equipment maker Toolex Alpha NV said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to take over ODME International BV.
ODME International is a privately-held Dutch company which is involved in the development, production, marketing, sales and service of optical media production equipment.
Toolex said that it had not yet signed a binding acquisition agreement and that the due diligence had not been completed.
"There can be no assurance that a definitive agreement will be reached or that the acquisition will be consummated," the company said.
Toolex, which is listed in Amsterdam and on NASDAQ but Stockholm-based, did not disclose financial details of the intended transaction.
